title: lastrea apiciflora
intro: Lastrea apiciflora, commonly known as the Rattlesnake fern, is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is native to Southeast Asia, where it grows on tree trunks and branches. The health benefits of Lastrea apiciflora include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, among others, although further research is needed to confirm these effects.
